description: Connection feasibility recomputed from a published daily series (specs/002 research R7, ADR-0006). Shared by the pipeline (Python) and the explorer (TypeScript); expected values are hand-computed. Edit only deliberately, with a review.
rule: Each entry of slack_min is the actual minutes from the inbound flight's arrival to the outbound flight's departure on one paired day, or null when a leg was cancelled (C) or diverted (D). With threshold = transfer_min + boarding_cutoff_min, a day is feasible when its code is not C or D and slack_min >= threshold. paired_days is the number of entries (cancelled and diverted days included); count_feasible the feasible days. When paired_days >= min_sample_days the status is ok and rate = count_feasible / paired_days rounded to 6 decimals; otherwise the status is insufficient_data and rate is null. Codes F and T describe the default assumptions only and are not used in the recomputation.

cases.name: boundary: slack equal to the threshold is feasible, one minute less is not
negative slack: the outbound left before the inbound arrived
cancelled and diverted days count as paired days that were not feasible
below the minimum sample: counts only, no rate
slider moved to a longer transfer time
slider moved to no transfer time
zero threshold: zero slack is feasible, negative is not
